name: gitlab-self-hosted
description: GitLab Self-Hosted workflows over OAuth MCP, with a first-class registered ChatGPT App binding path and explicit direct-MCP development fallbacks.

interface.shortDescription: GitLab via registered MCP App + OAuth
interface.longDescription: Use GitLab workflow skills with an OAuth-enabled MCP server. For ChatGPT plugin usage, register the remote HTTPS /mcp server in Developer mode, copy the platform-generated plugin_asdk_app... technical ID, and build the App-bound plugin variant so its manifest declares apps: ./.app.json. The public source package intentionally stays endpoint-neutral because registered App IDs are workspace-specific. Direct remote MCP and localhost remain explicit fallback/development paths.
defaultPrompt: List the GitLab groups and projects I can access.
